items:
Gulfstrand Up -

Located in the heart of Grayton Beach, Gulfstrand Up is a charming 3 bedroom, 2 bath duplex that sleeps 9 guests, with 2 queens, 1 full, 1 twin, and a queen sofa sleeper with memory foam mattress. These duplexes have become a favorite family destination in recent years. Beachy decor with comfortable furnishings lets you relax and enjoy the freedom of being at the beach. New interior paint throughout, complete kitchen remodel with new cabinets, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances, completely remodeled bathrooms, new bedroom flooring, new living room furniture, new bedding, new flat screen TV's in the living room and master bedroom. The community pool is 30' x 24. Easy beach access using the Grayton boardwalk just steps away. Parking for 1 vehicle, with extra parking on the east side of the community pool.

ALL ON ONE LEVEL (UPSTAIRS)
- Living room with queen sofa sleeper
- Newly remodeled full kitchen
- Dining area
- Queen master bedroom with private bathroom (shower/tub combination)
- Queen bedroom with shared hall bathroom (shower/tub combination)
- Full and twin bedroom with hall bath shared with queen bedroom
- Laundry room
- Balcony

*The community pool is typically heated during fall, holiday weeks, and spring break, but is based on the daily temperature and HOA discretion.

*Note – This property may have date restrictions that apply. All reservations submitted online are a request until receiving an email confirmation from Ocean Reef Resorts. For more details, please review our Minimum Night Stay under Rental Policies. An e-signed rental agreement is required prior to arrival.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

It’s a very short walk to the beach which we absolutely loved. The mattresses were very uncomfortable and don’t forget your blow dryer because there’s not one in the unit. Kitchen has minimal utensils and no Tupperware which was a little inconvenient but overall I would recommend this place.
